name: Yuu Yamanami
source:
Yuu is the sole civilian left aboard the Aries. She only speaks the bare minimum and prefers to act on her own. Her cold attitude tends to rub others the wrong way, but she doesn't necessarily have ill intentions. She takes a farsighted view on events, so she is rarely shaken by anything.
